question: In what manner and division should the offerings beginning with foot-water be given after bathing?
premises: Bathing is performed in proper order.
The offerings are divided into two or three parts.
inference: After bathing in due order, one should give the offerings beginning with foot-water in two or three parts.
plain_english: Having bathed in proper order, one should give the offerings beginning with foot-water in two or three parts.
